currentUserGoal: Add a ranked heal-over-time skill to manual touches and give it a satisfying, readable visualization without compromising large-field performance.
workCompleted: Added Green Afterglow as a ten-rank Touch Restoration Memory branching from Ancient Heartwood rank 1.

Each accepted manual touch adds one four-second healing stack. Rank 1 adds 0.40 Care per second per stack with a two-stack cap; rank 10 adds 0.85 Care per second per stack with a six-stack cap, before global manual-power bonuses.
Repeated touches at the stack cap refresh the four-second duration without creating per-touch timers or collections.
Applied actual Afterglow healing on the fixed production tick and credited useful healing to manual Care totals, while preventing revival after Ancient HP reaches zero.
Kept Run 1 deliberately unaffected even when prototype Memories are debug-unlocked.
Persisted both the permanent Memory rank and an active field's current Afterglow rate and remaining duration; legacy saves default safely to zero.
Added Memory Web node placement, warm-sunlight icon art, detail copy, costs, prerequisites, selected-node behavior, semantic controls, readable status, and debug dataset fields.

Added a green-gold plot bloom, a pooled restorative spore traveling from the touched tile to the HP bar, an HP-bar arrival flash and ongoing restorative shimmer, green active HP copy, and live Care-per-second feedback in the touch summary.
Kept the visualization bounded to six unmasked travel motes plus the existing impact pool, independent of logical field size.
Reset the browser playtest to a clean Run 1 after verification.
